# MudShadcn

> MudShadcn gives every MudBlazor component the shadcn/ui look: a MudTheme and one stylesheet, in light and dark mode. It adds no components and forks nothing: an app keeps writing ordinary MudBlazor, with MudBlazor's full API, and it renders with shadcn/ui's neutral palette, flat bordered surfaces, radius scale, focus rings and sizes. Charts get shadcn's chart colours. Installing MudShadcn also installs MudBlazor, as the separate NuGet package it is (not bundled inside MudShadcn), so MudShadcn is the only package an app has to reference. Written against MudBlazor 9.12.0, for .NET 10. That MudBlazor version is a minimum, not a lock: an app that references a newer MudBlazor itself gets the newer one, and an older one fails the restore (NU1605). `MudShadcnTheme.Create(new ShadcnThemeOptions { … })` gives what shadcn/create offers, under shadcn's names: the styles Vega, Nova, Maia, Lyra, Mira, Luma, Sera and Rhea next to the original look (New York), seven base colours, seventeen theme colours, chart colours, radius, fonts and menu options; each style is a small stylesheet the provider links by itself. `Enabled="false"` on the provider switches back to MudBlazor's own look at runtime. MIT licensed.

Install from NuGet as `MudShadcn`, call `builder.Services.AddMudShadcn()`, link `_content/MudBlazor/MudBlazor.min.css` and then `_content/MudShadcn/MudShadcn.min.css`, and put one `<MudShadcnProvider />` in the layout. This site is a Blazor WebAssembly app, so a plain HTTP fetch of a page returns an empty shell: read the plain-text resources below instead.

## AI and agent resources
- [Agent skill](https://mudshadcn.pages.dev/skill.md): set-up for every Blazor hosting model, the shadcn/ui to MudBlazor mapping (which Variant and Color give each shadcn component), theming, charts and the mistakes that break the styling. Has Claude Code skill frontmatter.
- [Full documentation](https://mudshadcn.pages.dev/llms-full.txt): the reference as one Markdown file: the provider's parameters, switching looks at runtime, charts, styles and theme options, the palette mapping, where MudShadcn differs from shadcn/ui, and versions.

## Showcase pages
- [Installation](https://mudshadcn.pages.dev/getting-started/installation): the four set-up steps and the shadcn/ui vocabulary in MudBlazor.
- [Use Cases](https://mudshadcn.pages.dev/getting-started/use-cases): the set-up for each situation (a new app, an app that already uses MudBlazor, a newer or older MudBlazor version, your own providers, each hosting model) and how to switch between the shadcn look and MudBlazor's own at runtime.
- [Icons](https://mudshadcn.pages.dev/customization/icons): `ShadcnThemeOptions.IconLibrary` (Lucide, Tabler Icons, HugeIcons, Phosphor Icons, Remix Icon): the icons of MudBlazor's components that a library redraws, what happens to the icons in your own markup, how to use any other icon of the library as an SVG string, with examples and the full list.
- [Theme](https://mudshadcn.pages.dev/customization/theme): the palette and tokens, light and dark, and how to customise them.
- [Theme Generator](https://mudshadcn.pages.dev/customization/theme-generator): shadcn/create's options (preset, style, base colour, theme, chart colour, heading font, font, icon library, radius, menu) on a live preview of MudBlazor components, applied to the whole site, with the `MudShadcnTheme.Create(new ShadcnThemeOptions { … })` code to copy and a link that opens the page in the same design.
- [Charts](https://mudshadcn.pages.dev/customization/charts): `MudShadcnChartOptions`, the chart option presets (bar, stacked bar, line, area, donut) shown as shadcn's chart cards with their code, and how `MatchBoundsToSize` and `--shadcn-chart-bar-radius` affect sizes.
- [RTL Languages](https://mudshadcn.pages.dev/customization/rtl-languages): right-to-left layouts (Kurdish, Arabic, Hebrew): `MudShadcnProvider` inside MudBlazor's `MudRTLProvider`, with examples. The button in the site's top bar (or `?dir=rtl` in the address) shows any page right-to-left.
- [Components](https://mudshadcn.pages.dev/docs/overview): every MudBlazor component page and documented example, in mudblazor.com's menu order, running on MudShadcn. Each component is at `https://mudshadcn.pages.dev/components/<name>`, for example `/components/button`, `/components/datagrid`, `/components/datepicker`, `/components/barchart`.
- [Releases](https://mudshadcn.pages.dev/releases): the changelog and the current package version.

## Package and source
- [NuGet package](https://www.nuget.org/packages/MudShadcn)
- [Source code on GitHub](https://github.com/sardar97/MudShadcn)
- [Changelog](https://github.com/sardar97/MudShadcn/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md)
- [MudBlazor](https://mudblazor.com), the component library it styles, and [shadcn/ui](https://ui.shadcn.com), the design it follows.
